import re

answer_cell = "C19"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb.active

ans_row, ans_col = coordinate_to_tuple(answer_cell)

total = Decimal("0")
num_re = re.compile(r'[-+]?(?:\d+(?:,\d{3})*|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?|[-+]?\.\d+')

# Sum numeric portions of cells in the answer column, above the answer cell, that contain '*'
for row in range(1, ans_row):
    val = ws.cell(row=row, column=ans_col).value
    if val is None:
        continue
    text = str(val)
    if "*" not in text:
        continue
    match = num_re.search(text.replace("$", ""))
    if match:
        try:
            total += Decimal(match.group(0).replace(",", ""))
        except InvalidOperation:
            pass

# Write a literal numeric value, not a formula
if total == total.to_integral_value():
    ws[answer_cell] = int(total)
else:
    ws[answer_cell] = float(total)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
